turns.text: In September 2026, the average order value (AOV) was **€114.39**, based on €12,582.75 in revenue across 110 non-cancelled orders.

args.sql:

       COUNT(order_id) AS orders_not_cancelled,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(amount), COUNT(order_id)) AS average_order_value_eur
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
  AND order_date >= '2026-09-01'
  AND order_date < '2026-10-01'

turns.text: In September 2026, the cost per acquisition (CPA / cost per booking) for the **Search** channel was **€124.84** (based on a total ad spend of €3,870 across 31 bookings).

args.sql:
WITH search_campaigns AS
  (SELECT campaign_id
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search' ),
     spend_sept AS
  (SELECT SUM(spend) AS total_spend_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend`
   WHERE campaign_id IN
       (SELECT campaign_id
        FROM search_campaigns)
     AND spend_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' ),
     bookings_sept AS
  (SELECT COUNT(booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings`
   WHERE campaign_id IN
       (SELECT campaign_id
        FROM search_campaigns)
     AND booked_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' )
SELECT s.total_spend_eur,
       b.total_bookings,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(s.total_spend_eur AS FLOAT64), CAST(b.total_bookings AS FLOAT64)), 2) AS cpa_eur
FROM spend_sept s
CROSS JOIN bookings_sept b

turns.text: The win rate (lead-to-booking rate / conversion rate) for search leads created in September 2026 was **33.70%**, with **31** bookings converted out of **92** total search leads within the standard 30-day conversion window.

args.sql:
WITH search_campaigns AS
  (SELECT campaign_id
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search' ),
     sept_leads AS
  (SELECT l.lead_id,
          l.created_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` l
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date >= '2026-09-01'
     AND l.created_date < '2026-10-01' ),
     lead_bookings AS
  (SELECT l.lead_id,
          COUNT(DISTINCT b.booking_id) AS bookings_count
   FROM sept_leads l
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` b ON l.lead_id = b.lead_id
   AND b.booked_date >= l.created_date
   AND b.booked_date <= DATE_ADD(l.created_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
   GROUP BY l.lead_id)
SELECT COUNT(lead_id) AS total_search_leads,
       COUNTIF(bookings_count > 0) AS converted_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(bookings_count > 0), COUNT(lead_id)) * 100, 2) AS lead_to_booking_rate_pct
FROM lead_bookings

turns.text: I assumed 'the last two full weeks' relative to Thursday 1 October 2026 refers to the two completed Monday-to-Sunday weeks from Monday 14 September 2026 through Sunday 27 September 2026. The total ad spend over the last two full weeks (14 September 2026 to 27 September 2026) was **€2,985** (€1,500 in the week of 14–20 September and €1,485 in the week of 21–27 September).

WITH weekly_spend AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(spend_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start_date,
          DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(spend_date, WEEK(MONDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS week_end_date,
          SUM(spend) AS ad_spend_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`ad_spend`
   WHERE spend_date >= '2026-09-14'
     AND spend_date <= '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY week_start_date,
            week_end_date)
SELECT week_start_date,
       week_end_date,
       ad_spend_eur
FROM weekly_spend
ORDER BY week_start_date

SELECT '2026-09-14 to 2026-09-27' AS period,
       SUM(spend) AS total_ad_spend_eur
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`ad_spend`
WHERE spend_date >= '2026-09-14'
  AND spend_date <= '2026-09-27'

turns.text: For the fiscal year 2026 to date (from 1 February 2026 through 6 October 2026), the net revenue is **€19,521.84** (gross revenue of **€19,611.59** minus returns of **€89.75**).

args.sql:
WITH fiscal_window AS
  (SELECT fiscal_year AS fy_start_date,
          DATE '2026-10-06' AS as_of_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE date_day = DATE '2026-10-06' ),
     revenue AS
  (SELECT SUM(o.amount) AS gross_revenue_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` o
   CROSS JOIN fiscal_window fw
   WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
     AND o.order_date >= fw.fy_start_date
     AND o.order_date <= fw.as_of_date ),
     RETURNS AS
  (SELECT SUM(r.amount) AS returns_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` r
   CROSS JOIN fiscal_window fw
   WHERE r.return_date >= fw.fy_start_date
     AND r.return_date <= fw.as_of_date )
SELECT COALESCE(r.gross_revenue_eur, 0) AS gross_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(ret.returns_eur, 0) AS returns_eur,
       COALESCE(r.gross_revenue_eur, 0) - COALESCE(ret.returns_eur, 0) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM revenue r
CROSS JOIN RETURNS ret;

turns.text: On Thursday, 24 September 2026, revenue was **€542.00**, up **21.12%** compared to the same weekday a week earlier (Thursday, 17 September 2026: **€447.50**), representing an increase of **€94.50** based on the week-over-week revenue growth definition.

args.sql:
WITH daily_revenue AS
  (SELECT order_date,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
     AND order_date IN ('2026-09-17',
                        '2026-09-24')
   GROUP BY order_date)
SELECT curr.revenue_eur AS revenue_current_eur,
       prev.revenue_eur AS revenue_prior_week_eur,
       (curr.revenue_eur - prev.revenue_eur) AS revenue_diff_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(curr.revenue_eur - prev.revenue_eur, prev.revenue_eur) * 100, 2) AS growth_percentage,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(curr.revenue_eur - prev.revenue_eur, prev.revenue_eur) AS growth_ratio
FROM
  (SELECT revenue_eur
   FROM daily_revenue
   WHERE order_date = '2026-09-24') curr
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT revenue_eur
   FROM daily_revenue
   WHERE order_date = '2026-09-17') prev

turns.text: In September 2026, the channel that brought the most bookings was **search** with **31 bookings**.

args.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(c.channel, 'Unknown / No Campaign') AS channel,
       COUNT(b.booking_id) AS bookings_count
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`bookings` AS b
LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`campaigns` AS c ON b.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE b.booked_date >= '2026-09-01'
  AND b.booked_date <= '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY bookings_count DESC
